name: bokea-mobile
description: Bokeà for Android and iOS. Runs the web app from Bokeà/wwwroot inside Capacitor.

scripts.sync:android: npm run sync:web && cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run sync:web && cap sync ios
scripts.run:android: npm run sync:android && cap run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync:ios && cap run ios
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:ios: npm run sync:ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -archivePath ../../dist/Bokea.xcarchive archive
